target.note: Trees and Shrubs Online: to 1(-1.3?) m dbh. Packham stand diameters (0.14-0.22 m) are younger forest cohorts and are not this context. 1.3 m model plane; sources do not always state measurement height.
Packham 4-10 cm; OSU 5-10 cm. Packham trimmed-hedge leaves to 16 cm are excluded from this context.
TSO (3-)4-10 x 2.5-4 cm; JRC typically 10 x 7 cm. Union of cited widths; no joint length-width distribution.

Packham et al. 2012: often 30-40 m, occasionally 50 m in near-natural stands. Houston Durrant, de Rigo & Caudullo (European Atlas of Forest Tree Species): commonly 30-40 m, to 50 m. Gating is the mature typical, not the 50 m exceptional. OSU landscape 15-23 m is contextual and is not substituted.
